FN-3YYBZZE-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 141
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Kenyatté Hassell
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 02/07/2025
House Bill 141 as introduced would increase the obligations of the State Comptroller's Office
by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost of any additional staff hired to process
state employee payroll deductions for certain financial instruments.
